$description: CodeEditor (platform/components/CodeEditor, library wave 6, lane A): its component tokens. The field is the Input’s (fill, border, corners, states); the code is the CodeBlock’s (font, size, line height, padding, syntax colors).

code-editor-border-width.$description: CodeEditor: the field’s border width, and the gutter’s divider.

code-editor-hover-border-color.$description: CodeEditor: the border under the pointer.

code-editor-focus-border-color.$description: CodeEditor: the border while the editor has focus (border color only).

code-editor-invalid-border-color.$description: CodeEditor: the border of an invalid editor.

code-editor-readonly-background.$description: CodeEditor read-only: the read-only fill (the Input’s).

code-editor-disabled-text.$description: CodeEditor disabled: the code in the disabled color (no syntax colors read as active).

code-editor-text.$description: CodeEditor: the code’s plain text (the CodeBlock’s); the syntax colors are the CodeBlock’s token roles.

code-editor-caret-color.$description: CodeEditor: the caret (the field’s text color).

code-editor-placeholder-text.$description: CodeEditor: the placeholder of an empty editor.

code-editor-font-family.$description: CodeEditor: the code font (Reddit Mono), as CodeBlock.

code-editor-font-size.$description: CodeEditor: the code’s size, as CodeBlock.

code-editor-line-height.$description: CodeEditor: the line height of the code and the line numbers (they must match), as CodeBlock.

code-editor-padding-block.$description: CodeEditor: the space above the first line and below the last.

code-editor-padding-inline.$description: CodeEditor: the space on each side of the code.

code-editor-height-sm-min-height.$description: CodeEditor height sm: the least height (about 5 lines).

code-editor-height-md-min-height.$description: CodeEditor height md: the least height (about 10 lines).

code-editor-height-lg-min-height.$description: CodeEditor height lg: the least height (about 20 lines).

code-editor-tall-max-height.$description: CodeEditor tall: the most it grows before it scrolls (the tall CodeBlock’s).

code-editor-gutter-text.$description: CodeEditor: the line numbers, secondary text.

code-editor-gutter-border-color.$description: CodeEditor: the divider between the line numbers and the code.

code-editor-gutter-padding-inline.$description: CodeEditor: the space on each side of the line numbers.

code-editor-gutter-layer.$description: CodeEditor: the gutter lies over the code that scrolls under it sideways.
